jobs.title: ISA Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. This role will give you the opportunity to play a pivotal part in further establishing our presence in the UK market, work with some of the best technology in the industry, and travel regularly to our Berlin HQ to spend time with the wider operational team, build relationships and take part in team activities. What you’ll do: Act as the subject matter expert for Upvest’s Stocks and Shares ISA transfer processes (cash and in-specie, inbound and outbound, using Equisoft), along with other S&S ISA processes and edge cases including those around APS, oversubscriptions, voids and ISA reporting. Run the daily operational cycle: work exceptions, failed or delayed settlements, rejected and aged transfers, and breaks, and escalate and resolve them within regulatory and client timescales. Build strong relationships with our clients’ operations teams and help them support their end users with ISA-related queries, explaining complex topics clearly to non-specialists. jobs.title: Werkstudent / Praktikant (m/w/d) – Product Management, Operations & International Expansion
jobs.description: Über STRIVE STRIVE Nutrition ist eine wachsende Premium-Marke für pflanzliche Bio-Proteine und hochwertige Supplements. Unser Anspruch ist es, außergewöhnlich gute Produkte mit kompromisslosem Qualitätsanspruch zu entwickeln – von der Auswahl der Rohstoffe über Rezeptur und Produktion bis zu Verpackung und Markteinführung. Wir vertreiben unsere Produkte insbesondere über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop und befinden uns aktuell in einer besonders spannenden Wachstumsphase: Unser Sortiment wird deutlich erweitert, bestehende Produkte werden weiterentwickelt, das Design komplett überarbeitet, neue Lieferketten aufgebaut und gleichzeitig bereiten wir unsere internationale Expansion vor. Für diese dynamische Wachstumsphase suchen wir engagierte Verstärkung in zentraler Funktion. Deine Rolle Als Werkstudent oder Praktikant im Bereich Product Management, Operations & International Expansion arbeitest du direkt mit den Gründern an den operativen Grundlagen unseres Wachstums. Du begleitest den gesamten Weg eines Produkts: von der Suche nach geeigneten Rohstoffen und Lieferanten über Preisverhandlungen und Produktionsplanung bis hin zu Verpackung, Qualitätsmanagement und internationaler Markteinführung. Damit erhältst du einen ungewöhnlich umfassenden Einblick darin, wie eine physische Consumer Brand tatsächlich aufgebaut und skaliert wird. Deine Aufgaben Einkauf & Supplier Management Identifikation geeigneter Rohstoff-, Verpackungs- und Produktionspartner in Deutschland, Europa und international sowie Einholen und Bewerten von Angeboten Kommunikation mit bestehenden und potenziellen Lieferanten Unterstützung bei Preis-, Mengen- und Konditionsverhandlungen Aufbau und Pflege einer strukturierten Lieferanten- und Beschaffungsübersicht Produktentwicklung & Launch Management Operative Begleitung neuer Produkte von der ersten Idee bis zur Markteinführung Koordination von Produktmustern, -Analysen und Testproduktionen Unterstützung bei Rohstoff- und Verpackungsentscheidungen

jobs.title: 3D Concept & Visualization Artist (m/f/d) (Freelance / Working Student)
jobs.description: About Dufour Dufour provides sovereign, automated aerial logistics capabilities. Transitioning from a UAV developer into a defence-first network provider, we deliver complete, repeatable operating systems – combining automated aircraft fleets, control rooms, training, and support – to keep critical supplies moving when conventional infrastructure is disrupted. The Role We are looking for a creative and tech-savvy 3D Concept & Visualization Artist to bring our new aircraft designs to life through compelling photorealistic and concept renderings. Working closely with our communications team, you will visualize our upcoming aircraft platforms in real-world mission scenarios – while providing clean base renders that enable our team to generate fast variations using AI tools. What You Will Do Aircraft & Scenario Renderings : Create photorealistic and concept renderings of our new aircraft platforms operating across diverse environments and mission scenarios. 3D Modeling & Scene Setup : Prepare, optimize, and texture existing CAD models, or build complementary concept assets, environments, and lighting setups from scratch. AI-Ready Base Assets & Enablement : Deliver clean, structured base renders and transparent cutouts that enable our internal team to independently generate quick variations and new backgrounds using AI tools. What You Bring 3D & Rendering Tools : Solid experience in 3D modeling and rendering or real-time engines, such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Rhino, Unreal Engine, KeyShot, or Vizcom. AI Workflows & Post-Production : Experience with AI-assisted visualization tools like Vizcom or ComfyUI and image editing – ideally knowing how to structure base renders for downstream AI workflows; basic 3D animation skills are a plus. Eye for Realism & Design : Strong sense of lighting, scale, and industrial or aerospace aesthetics to translate complex hardware into compelling scenes. High Flexibility & Reliability : Pragmatic and responsive – able to jump in on short notice

The soap you wash your hands with, the laptop you’re looking at right now, and even the concrete sidewalk under your feet. That’s a $6T industry .
